model.html:
Level: INE median €/m² of T3 flats actually sold in the parish (2026Q2: €4,429/m², a 12-month rolling median, so it lags ~6 months). Month-to-month movement: INE's bank-appraisal median for Lisbon apartments (to 2026-08). Typical 122 m² T3 today ≈ €569,081.

Purchase €555,000 vs typical €404,899 then (+37%): part renovation + lift + micro-location, part the 2021 Golden-Visa buying rush (Lisbon's residential route closed Jan 2022). That premium fades with a 4-yr half-life toward the live peer premium: 5 renovated lift-served listings of 30 checked, at asking −7% → +8% vs typical. Premium now +19%.

*“As this flat” = asking × (122 m² / its m²)^0.9 × (1 − 7% asking-to-sale gap).
